scene.placeText: the long covered bridge of painted timber over the clear stream of her world's golden capital at sunrise — red-lacquered pillars, a gate tower at each end, countless tiny gold spangles hung along the eaves flashing in the first light, and round grass-green mounds and dark-tiled palace roofs beyond the water
scene.ownProp: a short gold sword in its sheath, the hilt and scabbard covered in swirling gold granulation and inlaid with deep-red garnets
scene.outfit: a gold-winged knight look fitted to her body — a sculpted gold breastplate that leaves her shoulders and midriff bare, a short tabard of deep jade-green silk slit high at both hips, light gold plates at her forearms and shins, wings of thin cut gold sheet edged with trembling spangles spreading behind her shoulders, a gold helm-circlet of branching uprights hung with spangles and green jade commas around her topknot, and gold-laced sandal boots
scene.scene: she is the gold-winged knight who keeps the bridge gate of the golden capital, striding down the middle of the covered bridge on her morning watch with her sheathed gold sword held at her side and her gold-sheet wings catching the sunrise

prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Korean woman — the personification of Gyeongju — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Gyeongju as her world knows it — a golden capital of an eastern myth-world in a basin of low green hills: pale granite and dark pine wood, red-lacquered pillars under gently upswept dark-tiled eaves, thin hammered gold hung with trembling gold spangles, curved green jade, silk and lacquered wood, lantern-light and drifting spirit lights, cherry blossoms with softly glowing petals. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, the star tower, the great grass mounds or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: the long covered bridge of painted timber over the clear stream of her world's golden capital at sunrise — red-lacquered pillars, a gate tower at each end, countless tiny gold spangles hung along the eaves flashing in the first light, and round grass-green mounds and dark-tiled palace roofs beyond the water
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Outfit: a gold-winged knight look fitted to her body — a sculpted gold breastplate that leaves her shoulders and midriff bare, a short tabard of deep jade-green silk slit high at both hips, light gold plates at her forearms and shins, wings of thin cut gold sheet edged with trembling spangles spreading behind her shoulders, a gold helm-circlet of branching uprights hung with spangles and green jade commas around her topknot, and gold-laced sandal boots, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress, not regalia — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of hand-woven linen, silk, cotton and wool, with laced, tied or hooked closures, embroidered hems and soft leather shoes or boots; nothing synthetic, no zips, no printed logos.
POSTURE: walking.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera slightly above, looking down at her; a soft out-of-focus object of the place sits in the near foreground at one edge of the frame.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a short gold sword in its sheath, the hilt and scabbard covered in swirling gold granulation and inlaid with deep-red garnets at chest height; it is all she holds.
LEGS: mid-stride, one heel lifting.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: an unposed in-between expression, mouth caught mid-shape, brows natural.
Scene note: she is the gold-winged knight who keeps the bridge gate of the golden capital, striding down the middle of the covered bridge on her morning watch with her sheathed gold sword held at her side and her gold-sheet wings catching the sunrise

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a short gold sword in its sheath — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.

Avoid: Nothing from our present day in her world: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, jeans, hologram, billboard, car, machinery, denim, bomber jacket, cowboy hat, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles, sunglasses, bucket hat, beanie, sun visor, acetate.
